implementation.name: original-v1-depthwise-pointwise-channels
implementation.scope: The source has three input channels and two outputs at one spatial position, with depth multiplier one. Declared toy values: each 3 × 3 patch is constant 1, 2, or 3. Standard filters use weights 1 and 2. Depthwise weights are 1; pointwise rows are [1,1,1] and [1,0,−1]. Same shape does not imply equivalent layers.
implementation.question: Which spatial results can both output channels reuse?

purpose: Standard outputs accumulate channel contributions independently. Factorized computation produces three spatial intermediates, retains them through both mixing consumers, then releases them.
storyboard: The verified original standard and factorized path panels are the primary diagram. Output/intermediate readouts occupy their original nodes; read/compute payloads follow those nodes. The live allocation detail below magnifies the same values. Intermediate release fades in place after both mixers consume them. Standard outputs accumulate channel contributions independently. Factorized computation produces three spatial intermediates, retains them through both mixing consumers, then releases them. On phones, Follow operation uses a narrow window in the original source coordinates, with pending SVG packets and camera motion frozen together on Pause; Whole remains available.
guard: The declared parameterizations produce different outputs. Same shape and fewer MACs do not establish arbitrary standard-convolution equivalence or speedup.
